title: Guard int.parse(sel.profileId) in tutored_write_router.dart
rule: EH-3/EH-4 (unhandled exception type breaks the class's stated contract)
why: The class doc says 'CF failures... are re-thrown as TutorWriteException so callers can surface a clear snackbar,' but int.parse(sel.profileId) is called unguarded at 10 sites before any CF call happens. If profileId is ever non-numeric (malformed TutoredProfileSelection, future ID-scheme change), a raw uncaught FormatException propagates instead of the documented TutorWriteException — no AppLogger context, and callers that specifically catch TutorWriteException per this class's contract won't catch it. No test in s1_tutored_write_router_test.dart exercises a non-numeric profileId, so this is unconfirmed in practice.
recommendation: Parse once via a small helper (e.g. `_profileIdOrThrow(sel)`) that logs via AppLogger and throws a typed TutorWriteException on failure, matching the class's documented error contract; call it once instead of int.parse at each of the 10 sites.
acceptance_criteria: A test that constructs a TutoredProfileSelection with a non-numeric profileId and calls any pushX method asserts a TutorWriteException (not FormatException) is thrown and logged.
